admission.justification: Spans PinnedDependencyTests dependency/query guard and read_anchors/extents shared qualified holder containment, guarded by dependency-pin and shared-containment tests.

applicability: Catalog tree-sitter dependency pin checks in PinnedDependencyTests and qualified symbol lookups in read_anchors._defining_extents and extents.qualified_spans.
conditions: language_catalog.load_language_catalog().tree_sitter.version aligns tree-sitter at 0.26.1 with mcp/pyproject.toml, mcp/uv.lock, and the installed distribution, with zero tree-sitter-* grammar package dependencies.
PinnedDependencyTests verifies the catalog tree-sitter pin, dependency purity, and default catalog provider query compilation without dead OFFLINE_PROBE code.
read_anchors._defining_extents delegates to extents.qualified_spans so recorded-anchor reads apply the same enclosing-holder containment as writer and conversion.
exclusions: Exact-binding providers such as Lean resolve exact keys only and do not apply dotted holder containment.
statement: PinnedDependencyTests verifies the bundled language catalog's tree-sitter pin (0.26.1) against pyproject.toml, uv.lock, and the installed wheel, enforces zero privileged tree-sitter-* grammar dependencies, checks query compilation across default catalog providers without dead OFFLINE_PROBE, and read_anchors._defining_extents shares extents.qualified_spans holder-containment semantics.
title: Catalog tree-sitter pin matches lock/wheel and read_anchors shares containment
